title: Loop Control Keyword
pattern: Fill the missing control keyword in a loop according to the described behavior.
test_case_examples:
values=[1,2,3]
target=2
result=[]
for value in values:
    if value==target:
        continue
    result.append(value)
assert result==[1,3]
